Notes: Start of route
Head South on Mill Village Rd (LEFT out of main D2R2 field)
Turn right onto Stillwater Rd
RIGHT onto Hoosac Rd (which soon turns to dirt)
T-intersection, RIGHT onto Mathews Rd
RIGHT onto Boyden Rd (tiny driveway-sized road; the sign is 100 ft. past turn)
T-intersection, RIGHT onto Graves Rd (no sign)
T-intersection RIGHT onto Reeds Bridge Rd
STRAIGHT across onto Elmer Rd (after little bridge)
LEFT onto Newhall Rd (at top of steep little hill)
T-intersection, RIGHT onto Shelburne Falls Rd (climb)
LEFT onto Pine Hill Rd
Bear left to stay on Pine Hill Rd
LEFT to stay on Pine Hill Rd (dirt)
Continue straight, ignore road closure sign
Pavement: CAUTION: entering "The Bobsled Run" (steep twisty descent near bottom)
RIGHT at little grass triangle onto Upper Baptist Hill Rd (no sign)
RIGHT onto Ives Rd
Left to stay on Ives Rd
T-intersection, RIGHT onto Rt.116
LEFT onto Burkeville Covered Brodge
Stay right off bridge on Main Poland Rd (steep climb begins soon)
Summit, through cut in bedrock, "Poland Gate". CAUTION: the downhill is often rocky washboard.
RIGHT onto North Poland Rd
LEFT onto Bullitt Rd, dirt (no sign, just past driveway #536). CAUTION: possibly washout.
STRAIGHT across Rt 116 onto Murray Rd (little dirt lane)
LEFT at end of lane onto Hill Rd (no sign)
Fork left onto Burton Hill Rd
STRAIGHT across Rt 116 onto Creamery Rd (through grassy triangle)
T-intersection, LEFT onto Norton Hill Rd (no sign)
Quick fork RIGHT at triangle onto Steady Lane (sign only for Norton Hill)
Snacks & water at Steady Lane Farm on left, Open 7:00-10:00 Park bikes off road!
STRAIGHT across Rt 112 onto Lilliput Rd, dirt (no sign)
T-intersection, RIGHT onto Bug Hill Rd (no sign)
Continue straight: CAUTION: this intersection has no stop signs in any direction
RIGHT onto Old Stage Rd
Bear LEFT onto Hawley Rd (becomes Ashfield Rd 200 yds later at Hawley town line)
T-intersection, RIGHT onto Plainfield Rd
Right onto Buckland Rd
LEFT onto Pond Rd
T-intersection, LEFT onto Forget Rd
Heads up! RIGHT at phone pole onto little jeep track - this is actually East Rd
T-intersection, left to stay on East Rd
